Each athlete brought their own audience, sport, and personal story, which helped show how SKINS performs across very different environments, from match days and endurance training to gym sessions. Being able to discover and manage athletes from multiple markets so quickly, all in one place, made it easy for SKINS to run a truly international campaign and reach new audiences in an authentic way.

Each athlete independently created their own UGC-style collaborative Reels, action photos, and Stories, sharing their personal experience wearing SKINS. Because the content was self-shot and experience-led, it felt genuine and relatable, helping build stronger trust and credibility with their audiences while reinforcing SKINS’ performance-driven identity.

The campaign generated over 200,000+ combined views, delivering significant brand visibility and creating a valuable library of authentic athlete-generated content. By leveraging trusted athletes and real performance-led storytelling, SKINS successfully strengthened its credibility, reinforced its position as a leader in compression sportswear, and connected with new audiences across key European markets.

stories.title: Nuasan × Shelbourne FC Women — Women's Sports Market Entry
stories.blurb: Nuasan entered women's football through Rebecca Creagh, combining athlete-led Instagram promotion with recovery-focused product seeding across Shelbourne FC Women.
stories.full: Nuasan partnered with Sport Endorse to build relevance in women's sport by connecting with Rebecca Creagh, former Shelbourne FC player and current player liaison. Rebecca promoted Nuasan on Instagram and introduced its natural active-care range to the full Shelbourne Women's first-team squad for use around training and post-match recovery.
stories.quote:
A campaign-specific testimonial was not published for the Shelbourne activation. A broader Nuasan testimonial about using Sport Endorse, however, captures the access problem the platform solved for the growing brand: "I couldn't believe that I would now be able to access so many professional athletes."
- Maria O'Donnell, Sales & Market Manager, Nuasan
stories.objective:
Nuasan is an Irish natural skin and bodycare brand designed around active lifestyles, with products positioned for muscle, joint and skin care before and after activity. The brand wanted to expand its relevance within women's sport, but doing that credibly required more than simply sending products to a generic influencer. It needed access to a trusted person inside an established women's football environment who understood the demands of training, match preparation and recovery.

The campaign also needed to create two kinds of value at once. Nuasan wanted visible social-media advocacy, but it also wanted genuine product use within a team setting. That meant the right partner needed credibility with players, a natural connection to Shelbourne FC Women and enough familiarity with the squad to introduce the range without the activation feeling forced or transactional.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse connected Nuasan with Rebecca Creagh, a former Shelbourne FC player who was serving as the club's player liaison. That combination made her unusually well placed to bridge brand and team. Public Sport Endorse records state that Rebecca promoted Nuasan's natural and sustainable products on Instagram and provided the full Shelbourne Women's Squad with the Nuasan range to support post-match recovery and training.

The internal CRM evidence supports the same activation even though no dedicated campaign Deal could be located under Rebecca Creagh, Shelbourne or Nuasan-Shelbourne search terms. A HubSpot note dated 17 July 2024 records that Rebecca Creagh had provided Nuasan product to the full first team of Shelbourne Women's Squad. This gives the campaign a clear product-seeding component alongside Rebecca's social promotion.

The strategy was deliberately practical. Instead of positioning Nuasan only as a sponsor logo, the products were placed into the routine of an elite women's football squad, where recovery and bodycare were relevant to everyday performance. Rebecca's role gave Sport Endorse and Nuasan a credible route into the team while her Instagram activity created an outward-facing layer for the partnership.
stories.athletes:
Rebecca Creagh was a strong fit because her connection to Shelbourne was both sporting and operational. She had represented Shelbourne as a player and, by June 2024, was publicly described as a former player and current player liaison officer. That meant she understood the culture of the club, had direct access to the women's squad and could introduce Nuasan in a context where the products were relevant rather than artificially inserted.

Her background also gave the campaign authentic women's-football credibility. Creagh had competed at a high level in the Women's National League and had experienced the physical demands of elite football herself. For a brand seeking entry into the women's sports market, that credibility mattered: Nuasan was being represented by someone who could connect the product's recovery positioning with the realities of training and match play.
deliverables: Rebecca Creagh selected as the campaign link between Nuasan and Shelbourne FC Women.
Nuasan's active skin and bodycare range supplied to the full Shelbourne Women's first-team squad.
Products introduced for use around team training and post-match recovery.
Instagram promotion delivered through Rebecca Creagh to extend the activation beyond the squad.
Women's football product-seeding activation delivered through an established club environment.
Brand positioning reinforced around athlete wellness, recovery, natural ingredients and sustainable bodycare.
stories.results: The available records verify the team-wide seeding and Instagram activation but do not contain campaign-specific reach, impressions, engagement rate or sales-lift figures. The strongest documented outcome is the successful placement of Nuasan products across the full first-team environment, giving the brand authentic exposure within women's football.

AYA Supplements wanted a credible route into elite women's sport that connected its nutrition range with real performance, recovery and wellbeing needs. The brand needed a partnership with an established team, a clear performance rationale and a structure that could support both athlete use and wider consumer engagement throughout the season.

Sport Endorse brokered the partnership between AYA Supplements and the Kerry Senior Ladies for the 2024 season, securing official brand-partner status for AYA. The public partnership announcement confirmed that AYA would provide nutritional products formulated to support peak performance, recovery and overall wellbeing, while working with the team's coaching and nutrition staff to tailor supplementation strategies to athlete needs.

The partnership was designed to operate beyond the dressing room. AYA also committed to engaging Kerry supporters through product promotions, fan events and digital content, giving the collaboration both a performance-support layer and a consumer-facing activation layer. This created a regional platform through which the brand could build relevance with athletes, supporters and the wider women's-sport audience.

stories.title: Uriage × Conor O'Keeffe — Active-Skincare Campaign
stories.blurb: Uriage partnered with ultra-endurance coach Conor O'Keeffe for six months of authentic Instagram skincare content rooted in real outdoor performance.
stories.full: Uriage partnered with Sport Endorse to build active-skincare credibility through Irish ultra-endurance coach Conor O'Keeffe. The campaign used authentic Instagram video content to demonstrate skincare in a demanding outdoor context. An initial three-month booking was then renewed for a further three months, extending the collaboration to six consecutive months.
stories.objective:
Uriage needed a sports partner who could make dermatological skincare feel relevant to active consumers rather than forcing a conventional beauty endorsement into a performance setting. The brand's products are built around dermatological expertise and Uriage Thermal Water, with ranges focused on hydration, soothing, protection and skin-barrier care. To translate those benefits into sport, Uriage needed an athlete whose everyday environment naturally exposed skin to weather, sweat, repeated training and long periods outdoors.

The campaign also needed continuity. A single sponsored post could generate visibility, but it would provide limited opportunity to show product use over time or build a credible association between the brand and an endurance lifestyle. The stronger route was a recurring ambassador relationship with an athlete who could repeatedly integrate the products into content without making the partnership feel detached from his normal routine.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse connected Uriage with Conor O'Keeffe, an Irish ultra-endurance athlete and coach known for training and competing in demanding outdoor conditions. Sport Endorse's original case study records that Conor became an ambassador for Uriage skincare products and created engaging Instagram videos for an audience of almost 50,000 followers, using his active lifestyle to demonstrate the relevance of the range.

Internal HubSpot records add important commercial detail that was not visible in the public success story. The first booking covered June, July and August 2024, creating a structured three-month content programme rather than a one-off endorsement. A second HubSpot Deal was then created for September, October and November 2024 and classified as Existing Business. An internal October note confirms that a further three months had been agreed with Conor and Uriage.

That renewal extended the relationship to six consecutive months. While the CRM records reviewed do not provide campaign-specific impressions, views or engagement-rate figures, the documented extension is a useful B2B trust signal: the relationship progressed from an initial trial period into a second three-month booking instead of ending after the first activation.
stories.athletes:
Conor was a strong category fit because skincare protection and recovery could be demonstrated within a genuinely demanding routine. Sport Endorse described him as an ultra-endurance coach who thrives in all weather conditions, while independent coverage has documented his history as an ultrarunner. His public endurance profile therefore gave Uriage a credible way to talk about skincare outside a traditional beauty environment.

The audience fit mattered as well. The original Sport Endorse case study places Conor's Instagram following at almost 50,000 during the campaign. That gave Uriage access to a concentrated community interested in training, endurance and active lifestyles, while video allowed the brand to show product use in context rather than relying only on static product placement. The result was a partnership where the athlete, environment and product category reinforced one another.
deliverables: The available public and internal records confirm the following campaign structure and deliverables:
Conor O'Keeffe selected as Uriage's active-skincare ambassador through Sport Endorse.
Instagram video content created to demonstrate Uriage skincare within an outdoor endurance context.
Initial three-month content booking covering June, July and August 2024.
Renewal agreed for a further three months covering September, October and November 2024.
Six consecutive months of ambassador activity documented across the two HubSpot Deals.
Uriage positioned to Conor's almost-50K Instagram audience through authentic athlete-led skincare storytelling.

stories.title: Filorga × Dr Ciara Kelly — Beauty Brand Campaign
stories.blurb: Filorga partnered with Dr Ciara Kelly for a three-month Instagram campaign combining anti-ageing skincare education with credible, expert-led beauty content.
stories.full: Filorga partnered with Sport Endorse to activate a three-month Instagram campaign with Irish doctor and broadcaster Ciara Kelly. Across May, June and July 2024, Kelly created bespoke educational video content and regular stories around Filorga's anti-ageing skincare, combining professional credibility with an established beauty-focused social presence.
stories.objective:
Filorga needed to make a technically positioned anti-ageing skincare range accessible and relevant to everyday consumers. The brand draws on an aesthetic-medicine heritage and develops cosmetic products around specialist anti-ageing technologies, so a generic influencer placement risked reducing a more considered product story to simple visibility. The campaign needed a personality who could communicate skincare in an approachable way while still bringing authority to educational content.

The second challenge was consistency. A one-off post could introduce the products, but it would not give the brand much room to explain usage, reinforce key messages or repeatedly direct consumers towards stockists. A multi-month social programme offered a stronger route: recurring content could build familiarity with the Filorga name, present the anti-ageing range through different formats and keep the partnership visible over a sustained period rather than a single campaign moment.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse supported a collaboration between Filorga, GA Distribution and Ciara Kelly. Sport Endorse's original success story describes Kelly as a medical doctor, broadcaster and prominent beauty-focused social media personality. She created bespoke educational video content for her followers, with regular stories and content sharing designed to make the campaign informative as well as promotional.

A separate Sport Endorse article provides additional detail on the creative approach: Ciara's user-generated content highlighted Filorga's anti-ageing range through engaging videos and also informed audiences about stockists and pharmacies where the products could be purchased. This gave the campaign a practical conversion path alongside awareness, connecting product education with clear information on where consumers could find the range.

Internal HubSpot records confirm that this was a structured three-month programme rather than a single endorsement. The Deal "Filorga Ciara Kelly posts" records activity across May, June and July 2024 and was later marked Opportunity Completed, with a close date of 26 August 2024. The internal records reviewed do not contain verified impressions, video views, engagement rates or sales uplift, so no performance figures have been estimated.
stories.athletes:
Ciara was a strong talent fit because she combined several forms of credibility that are unusual in beauty partnerships. Her background as a medical doctor gave her an informed professional perspective, while her broadcasting career made her comfortable translating detailed subjects into clear, consumer-friendly communication. Sport Endorse also identified her as an established voice in the beauty space on social media, creating a natural bridge between expertise and lifestyle content.

That combination helped Filorga avoid a forced endorsement. The content could focus on explanation, product experience and availability rather than relying only on polished product placement. Regular Instagram stories supported frequency, while educational videos gave Ciara more room to discuss the anti-ageing range and direct followers towards pharmacies and stockists. For a brand positioned between advanced skincare and aesthetic expertise, that balance of authority, accessibility and social influence was strategically relevant.

Ciara Kelly selected for an expert-led Filorga skincare endorsement campaign through Sport Endorse and GA Distribution.

stories.title: Avonmore Protein Milk × Thammy Nguyen — Day-in-the-Life Series
stories.blurb: Avonmore Protein Milk followed weightlifter Thammy Nguyen through a real day, turning authentic athlete storytelling into multi-platform social content.
stories.full: Avonmore Protein Milk partnered with Sport Endorse to bring its "Bring Your All" platform to life through Irish weightlifter and Olympic prospect Thammy Nguyen. The campaign followed Thammy through a real day as an athlete, businesswoman and mother, using authentic documentary-style filming and distributing the resulting content across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
stories.objective:
Avonmore Protein Milk needed athlete content that felt broader and more human than a conventional product endorsement. The "Bring Your All" campaign centred on commitment to sport and exercise, so the creative had to show what that commitment looks like away from competition. For Thammy, that meant capturing the overlap between training, family life, work and everyday routines.

The content also needed to work across several social channels. A single polished film could tell the story, but short-form platforms required flexible cutdowns. The production therefore needed a strong hero asset plus shorter edits for social distribution.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse connected Avonmore Protein Milk with Thammy Nguyen and supported the campaign planning around a "Day in the Life" concept. Internal HubSpot correspondence from May 2023 shows that the production was developed through a pre-production process that included a storyboard and planning calls before filming.

The creative deliberately avoided an over-produced influencer aesthetic. The filming approach was designed to follow Thammy naturally through the day with very limited direction or second takes. A small two-to-three-person crew was planned so genuine moments could be captured without making the day feel staged.

The internal production plan called for a full day of filming, followed by a roughly one-minute summary film and four shorter cutdowns. Sport Endorse's published success story confirms that the finished "Day in the Life" content followed Thammy through her morning routine, family life, exercise sessions and work commitments. The wider "Bring Your All" campaign featured five ambassadors and was activated across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.
stories.athletes:
Thammy was a particularly strong fit because her story naturally supported the campaign idea. Sport Endorse described her at the time as an Irish Olympic prospect, businesswoman and mother, giving the creative several authentic dimensions beyond elite sport alone.

Weightlifting supplied performance credibility, while her business and family responsibilities made the content relevant to consumers balancing exercise with ordinary life. That combination helped Avonmore Protein Milk show sporting commitment through training, responsibilities and everyday routines. The documentary format strengthened the fit by building the story around Thammy's existing day rather than a scripted endorsement.
deliverables: The available public and internal records confirm the following campaign structure and production outputs:
Thammy Nguyen selected for Avonmore Protein Milk's athlete-led "Bring Your All" campaign through Sport Endorse.
Pre-production planning completed, including a storyboard and a dedicated pre-production meeting.
A full "Day in the Life" filming concept built around Thammy's real daily routine.
Completed content covering morning routine, family life, training and work commitments.
Production package planned around one approximately one-minute summary video plus four short-form cutdowns.
Multi-platform activation across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, with Thammy featured as one of five ambassadors in the wider campaign.
stories.results: The records reviewed do not contain verified campaign-level impressions, views, engagement rate, conversions or sales uplift, so none have been estimated. The strongest quantified evidence is structural: five ambassadors in the wider campaign, three social platforms, one full-day filming format and a planned five-piece video edit package. HubSpot also records the Avonmore/Thammy Deal as Opportunity Completed, confirming that the activation moved beyond planning into delivered campaign work.

stories.title: Skechers × Dean Rock & Nina Carberry — Flagship Store Launch
stories.blurb: Skechers Ireland turned its Dundrum flagship launch into a fan-focused event with two nationally recognised Irish sporting personalities.
stories.full: Shuz Group partnered with Sport Endorse to bring nationally recognised Irish athletes Dean Rock and Nina Carberry to the launch of Skechers Ireland's flagship store in Dundrum Town Centre. The in-store activation gave fans the opportunity to meet and speak with two sporting icons while helping the retailer create excitement around the new concept store.
stories.objective:
A flagship store opening needs more than a ribbon-cutting moment. Shuz Group wanted the launch of its new Skechers concept store in Dundrum Town Centre to attract attention, generate genuine public interest and give shoppers a reason to engage with the brand in person. The event needed recognisable talent with broad Irish appeal, rather than a generic celebrity appearance disconnected from sport, footwear or the local audience.

The second challenge was finding two personalities who could appeal across generations and sporting communities. The store serves men, women and children and presents both lifestyle and performance footwear, so the talent combination needed to feel inclusive. The activation also had to create a welcoming experience where fans could meet the athletes directly, not simply watch a staged appearance from a distance.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse brought together Dean Rock and Nina Carberry for the flagship-store launch. The original Sport Endorse success story describes a public meet-and-greet format in which fans of all ages could meet, talk with and create memories with the two athletes. This transformed the opening from a standard retail event into a community-facing sports activation built around personal interaction.

The venue reinforced the sense of occasion. Sport Endorse's published account identifies the location as the Skechers flagship store in Dundrum Town Centre, Dublin, and highlights the concept store's LED panelling at the shopfront and large LED display above the till. The modern retail environment supplied a strong visual setting, while the athletes gave the launch a distinctly Irish and human focal point.

Internal HubSpot records support the public case study. stories.athletes:
Dean Rock offered immediate relevance to a Dublin audience. Sport Endorse describes the former Dublin Gaelic footballer as an eight-time All-Ireland Championship winner, giving the event an athlete with exceptional local recognition and a career closely associated with the city. His presence connected the launch with one of Ireland's most widely followed sports and gave families and younger supporters access to a familiar sporting figure.

Nina Carberry broadened the activation beyond Gaelic games. The champion jockey also brought mainstream entertainment recognition through winning Ireland's Dancing with the Stars and appearing as a coach on Ireland's Fittest Family. Together, Rock and Carberry created a cross-sport pairing with complementary audiences: team sport and racing, Dublin identity and national visibility, elite performance and family entertainment. That mix made the endorsement feel locally grounded rather than artificially assembled.

Dean Rock and Nina Carberry selected as the two nationally recognised sporting personalities for the Skechers flagship-store launch.
Live in-store appearances delivered at Skechers in Dundrum Town Centre, Dublin.
Fan-facing meet, greet and conversation opportunities created for visitors of different ages.
Athlete participation integrated into the public launch of the LED-equipped Skechers concept store.
Two separate talent engagements recorded and completed in HubSpot during December 2023.
Combined campaign narrative published by Sport Endorse as a retail and event success story.

stories.title: Specsavers × Mike Haley — Rugby World Cup 2023 Activation
stories.blurb: Specsavers activated Rugby World Cup 2023 with Munster star Mike Haley, capturing authentic fan vox pops across two landmark Paris locations.
stories.full: Specsavers partnered with Sport Endorse to place Munster rugby player Mike Haley at the centre of its Irish Rugby World Cup 2023 activation. Across 22 and 23 September in Paris, Haley delivered on-camera vox pops at the Rugby Village and Stade de France, creating authentic tournament content for a multi-channel social rollout.
stories.quote: Following the activation, Carley Pieterse of Tangerine wrote: "Mike was fab and super easy to work with!" A later email also confirmed that the team was happy with the content and that more pieces would be released. Together, these comments provide a direct qualitative trust signal covering both talent professionalism and campaign output. 1 rugby professional → 2 Paris activation days → 2 landmark locations → authentic fan content built for multi-channel release.
stories.objective:
Specsavers wanted its Rugby World Cup activation to feel connected to the atmosphere surrounding the tournament, rather than operating as a remote or generic sponsorship message. The brand needed a recognisable rugby personality who could engage confidently with supporters in Paris, work naturally on camera and help translate live fan energy into useful digital content.

The practical challenge combined talent access, short lead times and live-event coordination. The campaign required an athlete with genuine Irish rugby credibility, availability during the tournament and the professionalism to operate across public locations with a production team. Contracts, approvals, scheduling and communication also had to move quickly enough to support activity on 22 and 23 September 2023, while preserving an informal vox-pop style that would not feel over-produced.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse connected Specsavers and its agency partner Tangerine with Mike Haley, a well-known Munster rugby player whose sporting profile matched the campaign. The internal HubSpot Deal, titled "Specsaver's Vox Pop Paris 22nd & 23rd September Mike Haley," records Trevor Twamley as Deal owner, Carley Pieterse of Tangerine as the associated contact and the project as an Opportunity Completed.

The public Sport Endorse success story confirms that Haley took part in on-camera vox pops in Paris at both the Rugby Village and the Stade de France. That structure placed him directly inside the supporter experience, allowing the content to draw on real reactions, live tournament excitement and the credibility of an active professional rugby player rather than relying on a studio-based endorsement.

HubSpot records show the Deal was created on 6 September 2023, followed by contract review, legal amendments, a final agreement signed by Mike and delivery of the activation later that month. The Deal closed on 2 October as Opportunity Completed. On 3 October, the agency confirmed that the team was happy with the content and that further pieces were still scheduled for release, demonstrating that the Paris shoot created a broader content bank rather than a single isolated asset.
stories.athletes:
Mike Haley was a strong fit because he combined elite rugby experience with direct relevance to Irish supporters. As a Munster player, he brought established sporting credibility and an audience connection that made sense for a Specsavers Rugby World Cup campaign aimed at the Irish market. stories.full: Sports Direct Ireland partnered with Sport Endorse to source elite GAA ambassadors for an Under Armour campaign designed to inspire 16-25-year-olds to train more consistently. Through the Sport Endorse platform, Sports Direct secured respected Galway footballers whose credibility and influence helped localise a global sportswear brand for the Irish market.
stories.objective:
As one of Ireland's leading sports retailers, Sports Direct wanted to strengthen Under Armour's connection with younger Irish consumers by making the brand more culturally relevant and authentic.

While Under Armour has a global roster of elite athletes, Sports Direct recognised that Irish consumers-particularly GAA players and grassroots athletes-respond more positively to ambassadors they know, trust and aspire to emulate.

The campaign required access to respected county footballers who embodied discipline, performance and consistency, while avoiding the time-consuming process of sourcing talent, negotiating commercial agreements and managing athlete communications individually.

Sports Direct also wanted to create a campaign centred around behaviour change rather than simply product promotion, encouraging 16-25-year-olds to make regular training part of their weekly routine
stories.approach:
Using the Sport Endorse platform, Sports Direct Ireland was able to identify and secure athlete ambassadors who perfectly aligned with Under Armour's performance positioning.

Sport Endorse streamlined the ambassador sourcing process by enabling the brand to:

Identify athletes matching the campaign brief.

Review suitable ambassador profiles.

Manage athlete communications.

Coordinate commercial agreements.

Secure campaign participation through one platform.

The platform eliminated much of the manual administration traditionally associated with athlete partnerships, allowing Sports Direct to focus on campaign execution and creative production.
stories.athletes:
The campaign featured Galway senior footballers Damien Comer and Paul Conroy, two of the county's most respected players.

Damien Comer brought leadership, physicality and elite performance credentials, having captained Galway and earned multiple All-Star nominations.

Paul Conroy offered experience, professionalism and long-term consistency, making him an ideal ambassador for Under Armour's training-first philosophy.

Together, the athletes represented more than sporting success-they demonstrated the commitment, resilience and work ethic that Under Armour encourages in athletes at every level.

Their authenticity helped position Under Armour not simply as performance apparel for elite professionals, but as a brand that supports anyone committed to improving through consistent training.
deliverables: Athlete ambassador sourcing through the Sport Endorse platform.
Selection and contracting of two elite inter-county GAA footballers.

Campaign messaging promoting training two to three times per week.

stories.title: Zambrero × Boidu Sayeh — World Hunger Day Event
stories.blurb: Sport Endorse connected Zambrero Ireland with GAA athlete Boidu Sayeh to amplify its inaugural World Hunger Day meal-packing event through authentic community engagement.
stories.full: Zambrero Ireland partnered with Sport Endorse to source GAA footballer Boidu Sayeh for its inaugural World Hunger Day meal-packing event in Dublin. The campaign combined athlete influence with community volunteering to generate positive media coverage, create engaging content and reinforce Zambrero's global mission to end world hunger through its Plate4Plate initiative.
stories.objective:
As Zambrero Ireland prepared to host its first-ever meal-packing event, the brand wanted to maximise awareness of both World Hunger Day and its wider social impact mission.

The event aimed to bring together volunteers to pack 30,000 meals for people experiencing food insecurity while showcasing Zambrero's Plate4Plate programme, where every eligible meal purchased funds another meal for someone in need.

To achieve meaningful media coverage and increase public participation, Zambrero required a recognisable Irish sporting personality who aligned naturally with the campaign's values. Rather than pursuing a traditional celebrity endorsement, the objective was to identify an athlete whose credibility, community profile and authenticity would strengthen the event's purpose-led messaging.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse sourced and secured Boidu Sayeh, one of Ireland's respected GAA footballers, to attend Zambrero's World Hunger Day activation at its Hatch Street restaurant in Dublin.

Using the Sport Endorse platform, Zambrero was able to identify an athlete who reflected the campaign's community-first ethos while simplifying the ambassador sourcing process.

Sport Endorse managed the athlete engagement from sourcing through to confirmation, enabling the Zambrero team to focus on delivering the live activation and coordinating media opportunities around the event.

Boidu participated directly in the meal-packing activity, engaged with volunteers and media, and took part in official photography that supported Zambrero's public relations and social media communications.
stories.athletes:
Boidu Sayeh was selected because his profile extended beyond sporting performance.

As a respected GAA footballer known for leadership, teamwork and community involvement, he represented the values Zambrero wanted associated with its mission. His authentic participation reinforced that this was a genuine volunteering initiative rather than a promotional appearance.

His involvement also helped localise Zambrero's global purpose within an Irish sporting context, making the campaign more relatable for consumers, media and community organisations.

By pairing a trusted athlete with a meaningful social cause, Zambrero created an endorsement that felt natural, credible and purpose-driven.

stories.title: SuperValu × Boidu Sayeh & Shairoze Akram — #BringItOn Inclusion
stories.blurb: SuperValu partnered with Sport Endorse to source authentic GAA ambassadors who brought credibility and representation to its nationwide #BringItOn inclusion campaign.
stories.full: SuperValu partnered with Sport Endorse to source authentic GAA ambassadors for its nationwide #BringItOn campaign, celebrating diversity and inclusion across Gaelic Games through connecting directly with Boidu Sayeh and Shairoze Akram, athletes whose personal stories embodied the campaign's purpose .  All managed seamlessly through our digital platform.
stories.quote: Community means including everyone. Through our partnership with the GAA, we wanted to celebrate the diversity already enriching Gaelic Games while encouraging even greater participation across communities throughout Ireland.
stories.quote_by: Ray Kelly, Marketing Director, SuperValu "What SuperValue are doing are so important. To bring communities together, bring people who don't feel like they're a part of the community into the community." "It's great to have someone to look up to and to see them just like you and aspire to be just like them as well" Boidu Sayeh, Westmeath Senior GAA Football Team "SuperValues partnership and campaign this year is really going to help push it on like Gaa are improving, the work J Tavros is doing it's slowly getting coaches and players educated and it's slowly coming about and it's good to see" Shairoze Akram, Mayo Senior GAA Team
stories.objective:
As title sponsor of the GAA All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, SuperValu wanted to evolve its sponsorship beyond traditional match-day visibility and champion a broader social purpose.

The objective was to demonstrate that Gaelic Games belong to everyone, regardless of ethnicity, nationality or background, while reflecting the changing face of modern Ireland. Achieving this required more than selecting well-known athletes-it demanded ambassadors whose lived experiences genuinely represented the campaign's message.

Finding athletes with authentic stories, proven sporting credentials and strong community influence can be a time-consuming process involving multiple agencies, negotiations and manual outreach. SuperValu required an efficient, trusted solution to identify ambassadors who aligned naturally with both the campaign's values and the GAA community.
stories.approach:
Using the Sport Endorse platform, SuperValu sourced two outstanding ambassadors Boidu Sayeh, and Shairoze Akram, whose journeys into Gaelic Games perfectly reflected the campaign's objective of promoting inclusion through sport.

Sport Endorse streamlined the ambassador sourcing process by enabling the brand to identify suitable athletes, assess authentic brand fit and manage talent engagement through a single platform.

The selected athletes became central figures within the wider integrated campaign, appearing across television, digital, social media, outdoor advertising and PR activity as part of SuperValu's national #BringItOn launch.

The campaign was developed alongside TBWA Ireland and supported by a media investment exceeding €1 million, ensuring widespread national visibility during the GAA Championship season.
stories.athletes:
Authenticity was fundamental to the campaign's success.

Boidu Sayeh and Shairoze Akram were not selected simply because they played inter-county football. Both athletes represented the growing diversity within Gaelic Games and demonstrated how sport can foster belonging, opportunity and community integration.

Their stories challenged traditional perceptions of who plays Gaelic Games while remaining deeply rooted in the values of local GAA clubs.

Rather than creating a conventional endorsement campaign, SuperValu placed genuine lived experience at the heart of its storytelling-making the campaign both credible and culturally relevant.

Athlete vetting and brand suitability assessment
Ambassador contracting and campaign coordination
National television campaign featuring selected ambassadors

stories.title: Specsavers × Kieran Donaghy — Local Legends Campaign
stories.blurb: Specsavers activated its GAA Hawk-Eye sponsorship by celebrating Kerry legend Kieran Donaghy, creating authentic local content.
stories.full: Specsavers partnered with Sport Endorse to activate its GAA Hawkeye sponsorship
stories.objective:
As the official sponsor of GAA Hawk-Eye, Specsavers had already secured strong visibility during Ireland's biggest Gaelic Games fixtures. The challenge was moving beyond logo placement and sponsorship recognition to create meaningful engagement with supporters.

Rather than focusing solely on the technology behind Hawk-Eye or traditional advertising, Specsavers wanted to develop a campaign that reflected the values of Gaelic Games-community, heritage and local pride. The objective was to create content that supporters would actively choose to watch and share, strengthening emotional affinity with the brand while complementing its broader "Should've Gone to Specsavers" positioning.

The campaign also required a personality whose reputation transcended sporting success and resonated authentically with GAA audiences nationwide.
stories.approach:
Working with its appointed communications agency, Tangerine Communications, Specsavers developed the Local Legends campaign as a content-led extension of its Hawk-Eye sponsorship.

Following careful consideration of several potential ambassadors, Kerry icon Kieran Donaghy was selected as the campaign's central figure.

Production took place in Tralee, allowing Donaghy to tell his own story within the community that shaped his career. Rather than creating a conventional commercial, the team produced a four-minute documentary-style feature exploring his relationship with Kerry football, local identity and the enduring importance of the GAA.

The campaign was distributed primarily through Facebook, where long-form social video was rapidly becoming a powerful channel for sports storytelling and community engagement.
stories.athletes:
Kieran Donaghy was an ideal ambassador for the campaign because he embodied both elite sporting achievement and authentic community identity.

As an All-Ireland winner, All Star and one of Gaelic football's most recognisable personalities, Donaghy carried credibility with supporters across Ireland. Equally important, his strong roots in Tralee and Kerry reinforced the campaign's "Local Legends" concept, ensuring the content felt genuine rather than promotional.

His natural storytelling ability, humour and approachable personality translated particularly well to long-form digital content.
deliverables: Strategic selection of Kieran Donaghy as campaign ambassador
Documentary-style video production filmed on location in Tralee
Approximately four-minute branded content feature
Social-first campaign distributed via Facebook
Community-focused storytelling supporting Specsavers' GAA Hawk-Eye sponsorship
Athlete interview and editorial content highlighting local GAA culture
Digital brand activation extending sponsorship beyond match days
Results

An enjoyable day in Tralee filming for the team resulted in a goal scoring 4-minute feature on Kieran, which racked up over 220K views on Facebook rapidly. Testimony to the enduring popularity of Star, and that "In Ireland, the GAA's massive, but in Kerry they call it a religion" as he said himself.

stories.title: Foróige × Jordan Lee — Leadership for Life Keynote
stories.blurb: Sport Endorse connected Foróige with Paralympian Jordan Lee to inspire 250 international youth delegates through an authentic leadership keynote.
stories.full: Foróige partnered with Sport Endorse to secure Irish Paralympian Jordan Lee as a keynote speaker for its 2022 Leadership for Life Conference. Using Sport Endorse's athlete network, Foróige connected with a speaker whose lived experience aligned perfectly with the programme's focus on resilience, leadership and personal development, delivering an inspiring session for 250 young delegates from seven countries.
stories.quote: My story is one of resilience, perseverance and determination. I really enjoyed speaking to these young leaders and giving them a detailed insight into my life story and what I've learnt from my experiences to help them learn to thrive in perceived difficult circumstances and be able to achieve their goals.
stories.quote_by: Jordan Lee, Irish International High Jumper & Paralympian
stories.objective:
Foróige's Leadership for Life Conference is the flagship event of its internationally recognised youth leadership programme. Returning as a full in-person event in 2022, the conference welcomed approximately 250 teenagers from Ireland, the United States, Ukraine, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Nigeria and South Africa for a week of leadership development at Maynooth University.

The organisation required a keynote speaker capable of delivering more than a motivational talk. They needed someone whose personal journey genuinely reflected the programme's core themes of resilience, determination, communication, empathy and leadership while connecting authentically with a teenage audience from diverse cultural backgrounds.

Finding speakers with both elite sporting credentials and a compelling personal story can often involve fragmented outreach, lengthy negotiations and multiple intermediaries. Foróige wanted a trusted partner to simplify the process and secure a speaker whose values closely aligned with the Leadership for Life programme.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse connected Foróige with Irish international high jumper and Paralympian Jordan Lee, whose journey of overcoming adversity through elite sport made him an ideal fit for the conference.

Working with Sport Endorse, the organisation was able to identify and engage a speaker whose lived experience complemented the conference's wider educational objectives. The engagement enabled Foróige to secure an athlete capable of translating lessons from high-performance sport into practical leadership principles relevant to young people.

Jordan joined an international speaker programme alongside anti-racism advocate Yemi Adenuga and Professor Mark Brennan, UNESCO Chair for Rural Community, Leadership and Youth Development at Pennsylvania State University, contributing a personal perspective on resilience, perseverance and self-belief.

Throughout his keynote, Jordan encouraged delegates to embrace challenges, develop confidence and refuse to allow setbacks or external negativity to define their ambitions.
stories.athletes:
Jordan Lee represented an exceptional strategic fit for the Leadership for Life Conference for several reasons.

As an Irish Paralympian and international athlete, he brought instant credibility while remaining relatable to a teenage audience. His lived experience of overcoming barriers aligned naturally with the programme's emphasis on personal development, resilience and leadership.

Rather than delivering abstract leadership theory, Jordan shared authentic experiences from his sporting career, demonstrating how perseverance, mindset and determination can help individuals overcome adversity and achieve ambitious goals.

His story reinforced the practical leadership skills delegates were developing throughout the week, including communication, confidence, teamwork and decision-making.
deliverables: Athlete sourcing and speaker recommendation
Speaker engagement and booking
Keynote address delivered at the Leadership for Life Conference 2022
Live audience presentation to approximately 250 international delegates
Participation within the conference's flagship leadership programme
Post-event testimonial provided by the athlete
Positive audience feedback reported by Foróige

Using the Sport Endorse platform, AYU reviewed a shortlist of accomplished Irish athletes and public personalities whose values closely aligned with the company's positioning.

Sport Endorse facilitated the ambassador sourcing process, enabling AYU to efficiently review suitable candidates before securing a partnership that would support both existing product lines and the launch of AYUGlo.

The campaign focused on building long-term brand equity rather than delivering a short-term promotional activation.

Nina Carberry represented an exceptional strategic fit for AYU.

One of Ireland's most recognised sporting personalities, Nina had built her reputation through decades of success in elite horse racing before successfully transitioning into television and mainstream media.

Her public image reflected many of the same characteristics that define the AYU brand:

Hard work

Authenticity

stories.title: VHI × Nina Carberry — 'More Than Running' parkrun Campaign

stories.full: Vhi partnered with Sport Endorse to support its nationwide More Than Running campaign by connecting with trusted Irish sporting ambassador Nina Carberry. The campaign promoted the physical, mental and social benefits of parkrun through authentic community participation, PR activity and live event appearances, helping reinforce Vhi's commitment to healthier communities across Ireland.
stories.objective:
Vhi wanted to launch a national awareness campaign that would reposition parkrun as an accessible community health initiative rather than a competitive running event. The objective was to encourage participation among people of all ages and fitness levels while reinforcing Vhi's long-term brand purpose of helping people live longer, stronger and healthier lives.

To achieve this, the campaign required a credible ambassador capable of appealing beyond traditional running audiences. The ambassador also needed to communicate authentic wellbeing messages across earned media, live activations and campaign content while aligning naturally with Vhi's trusted healthcare reputation.
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse supported the ambassador activation by connecting Vhi with former professional jockey and national sporting figure Nina Carberry, whose profile aligned strongly with the campaign's inclusive positioning.

Working alongside Vhi and parkrun Ireland, the campaign centred on community participation rather than elite performance. Nina attended multiple parkrun events across Ireland, participated alongside members of the public, generated earned media coverage and featured across campaign imagery and communications.

This integrated approach helped Vhi extend the campaign beyond traditional sponsorship into an authentic community health platform.
stories.athletes:
Nina Carberry was an ideal ambassador because she represented resilience, determination and everyday participation rather than professional running performance.

As one of Ireland's most recognised sporting personalities, she appealed to a broad demographic including families, recreational participants and those returning to exercise. Her personal experiences balancing work, family life and fitness enabled her to communicate the campaign's core message with credibility.

Rather than presenting exercise as intimidating or performance-driven, Nina demonstrated that parkrun welcomes everyone, whether walking, jogging, running or volunteering. This authenticity helped remove barriers to participation while reinforcing Vhi's inclusive health positioning.

stories.title: permanent tsb × Nhat Nguyen — Team Ireland Sponsorship

stories.full: Permanent TSB partnered with Sport Endorse to activate its landmark sponsorship of the Irish Olympic and Irish Paralympic Teams by connecting directly with Olympic badminton player Nhat Nguyen and a roster of elite Irish athletes. The campaign celebrated community, ambition and inclusion through a fully integrated national brand activation spanning retail, digital, PR and athlete ambassador content.
stories.quote: We see our community ethos as a key differentiator for Permanent TSB and like us the Olympic and Paralympics are grounded in communities across the country, so this is a perfect partnership. Athletic success depends on the support of families, friends, communities and coaches and our Olympians' and Paralympians' achievements inspire and raise the spirits of the entire nation. In 2022, Permanent TSB announced one of the largest brand partnerships in its history, becoming the first organisation to serve as title sponsor of both the Irish Olympic Team and Irish Paralympic Team during the same Olympic cycle.

The sponsorship represented more than a traditional sports partnership. As the bank underwent a wider brand transformation, it required authentic athlete ambassadors capable of bringing its values of ambition, courage, excellence and community to life across multiple marketing channels.

The campaign also needed to balance representation across Olympic and Paralympic sport while engaging audiences nationwide through both established champions and emerging talent.
stories.approach:
Working through Sport Endorse, Permanent TSB secured partnerships with elite Irish athletes whose stories aligned naturally with the campaign's strategic objectives.

Olympian Nhat Nguyen became one of the campaign's original ambassadors.

The ambassador programme formed part of a broader integrated activation supporting Team Ireland throughout the Paris 2024 Olympic cycle. Athlete partnerships were combined with national advertising, retail branch branding, digital content, public relations activity and community engagement initiatives to create a consistent brand platform that extended well beyond traditional sponsorship visibility.

As Paris 2024 approached, the programme expanded to feature a wider group of Team Ireland athletes across multiple Olympic and Paralympic disciplines.
stories.athletes:
Nhat Nguyen represented a particularly strong strategic fit for Permanent TSB.

As one of Ireland's leading badminton players and a Tokyo Olympian targeting success at Paris 2024, Nguyen embodied the campaign's focus on ambition, progression and high performance.

His personal journey, from moving to Ireland as a child to representing the country on the Olympic stage, also reflected the diversity and inclusivity that Permanent TSB sought to celebrate through its community-focused brand positioning.

Alongside other Olympians, Nguyen helped demonstrate that elite sporting success is built through the support of families, coaches, clubs and local communities-the central message behind Permanent TSB's "Raising A Nation" campaign.

Recruiting elite athletes presents unique challenges, however. Accessing current and recently retired sports stars often requires navigating multiple agents, governing bodies, personal representatives and scheduling conflicts, resulting in lengthy negotiations and fragmented communication.

For the 2022 series, ShinAwiL wanted to identify sporting personalities with broad public recognition, proven media appeal and the commitment required for a demanding live television competition. They required a streamlined recruitment process capable of connecting directly with suitable athletes while reducing administrative complexity and accelerating talent acquisition
stories.approach:
Sport Endorse provided ShinAwiL with a single platform through which the production team could efficiently identify, approach and engage elite athletes suited to the programme.

Using Sport Endorse, ShinAwiL was able to:

define the casting brief for suitable sporting personalities

identify relevant elite athletes based on profile and availability

communicate directly through a centralised platform

coordinate negotiations efficiently

manage contracting throughout the recruitment process

Following the recruitment process, former professional cyclist Nicolas Roche and champion National Hunt jockey Nina Carberry were confirmed as contestants for the 2022 series.

Both athletes proved exceptionally strong additions to the cast, remaining in the competition for multiple weeks and generating sustained media coverage throughout the season.
stories.athletes:
Selecting the right sporting personalities was critical to the success of the programme.

Nicolas Roche brought international sporting credibility as a former Tour de France rider and one of Ireland's best-known professional cyclists. Having recently retired from elite competition, he offered a compelling personal journey as viewers watched him develop new performance skills outside sport. His progression throughout the competition became one of the season's most engaging storylines.

Nina Carberry represented one of Ireland's most accomplished National Hunt jockeys and entered the competition with an established reputation for determination, professionalism and resilience. Her competitive mindset translated naturally into the programme, where consistent improvement ultimately led to victory alongside professional dance partner Pasquale La Rocca.

Together, the athletes broadened the programme's appeal across multiple sporting audiences while bringing authenticity, discipline and highly relatable personal stories to the series.
